name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.39-beta “Paris” (build 43): clearer menus and ribbon tabs.
• The ribbon tabs (Home, Document, Submission, Matter) are now a switcher like on the Mac, no longer plain text like the menu bar above.
• Menus show their groups clearly again, as on the Mac. Exhibit → History on the Server… sits in the first group, as on the Mac.
• Build 42: dark mode switches live, the ribbon as a card on the translucent Windows 11 background, Mica also in virtual machines and over Remote Desktop, and nothing cut off when maximized.
